beats.say: The Ballon d'Or ceremony is moving to London this Monday.
The event starts at 20:00 GMT on Monday 26 October inside the famous London Palladium Theatre.
This prestigious evening marks the 70th year of honouring the very best footballers on the planet.
According to the BBC, France Football magazine has organised this global prize ever since 1956.
The show is traditionally held in France, and Paris' Theatre du Chatelet has hosted it each year since 2019.
Now the UK takes centre stage for the milestone anniversary, shifting world football's grandest individual honours straight across the Channel.
Who do you think deserves to lift the golden trophy in London this year?

facts: The 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony will take place at 20:00 GMT on Monday, 26 October, at London's Palladium Theatre.
The ceremony is traditionally held in France, and has taken place in Paris' Theatre du Chatelet since 2019.
Back for its 70th year, the Ballon d'Or ceremony will once again recognise the best footballing talent in the world.
Run by France Football magazine since 1956, it is widely viewed as the pinnacle of individual prizes for professional footballers worldwide.
